name: audifact
description: Your bot keeps a signed receipt of its decisions. Logs consequential decisions, external actions and subagent delegations to Audifact's append-only, hash-chained ledger via the hosted MCP server at api.audifact.io/mcp. Requires an Audifact API key; events bill to that key's account.

AUDIFACT_API_KEY.title: Audifact API key
AUDIFACT_API_KEY.description: Your af_... key from audifact.io Dashboard -> API Keys. Sent only as the X-API-Key header to https://api.audifact.io/mcp. Events consume credits on this key's account.
